kebab_example: aliyun dm sender-statistics-detail-by-param --account-name s000@example.net --to-address b000@example.net --status 0 --start-time 2021-04-28_00:00 --end-time 2021-04-29_00:00 --tag-name EmailQuestionnaireHelioscam --length 5 --next-start '90f0243616#203#a000@example.net-1658817837#a000@example.net.247475288187' --ip-pool-id e42a4d8e-66e0-4ea3-88aa-74c66c661cef --config-set-id 95437e39-5433-4c6c-8b66-0c4eac2f4d97 --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SenderStatisticsDetailByParam

parameters.help_en:
The sender address. If you leave this parameter empty, emails from all sender addresses are queried.

You can leave AccountName, TagName, and ToAddress empty. You can specify a value for only one of these parameters at a time
parameters.help_zh:
发信地址。不填，代表所有地址。

AccountName、TagName、ToAddress可以都不填写。若填写，只能传递其中一个参数，不能同时传递两个或以上组合的参数
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The recipient address. If you leave this parameter empty, emails sent to all recipient addresses are queried
parameters.help_zh: 收信地址。不填，代表所有收信地址
parameters.name: to_address

parameters.help_en:
The delivery status. If you leave this parameter empty, emails in all delivery statuses are queried. Valid values:

0: delivered successfully

2: invalid address

3: spam

4: failed
parameters.help_zh:
投递结果。不填，代表所有状态。取值：

0：成功
2：无效地址
3：垃圾邮件
4：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time range between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 30 days. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，和结束时间跨度不能超出30天，格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time range between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 30 days. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，和起始时间跨度不能超出30天, 格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The email tag. If you leave this parameter empty, emails with all tags are queried.
When you send an email using SMTP, specify the \`TagName\` and its value for the \`X-AliDM-Trace\` field. For more information, see the examples for email tracking
parameters.help_zh:
邮件标签。不填，代表所有标签。
SMTP发信时，请参考邮件跟踪示例，对“X-AliDM-Trace”字段，指定标签字段"TagName"和对应值
parameters.name: tag_name

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return. The value can range from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定本次请求返回结果数目。范围是1~100
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en: The offset for this request, used for paging. If more results are available, set the \`NextStart\` parameter in your next request to this return value
parameters.help_zh: 分页用，指定本次请求的偏移量。如果还有更多结果，下次请求将该返回值设置到请求中的NextStart
parameters.name: next_start

parameters.help_en: The ID of the independent IP address pool
parameters.name: ip_pool_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the configuration set
parameters.name: config_set_id

NextStart.description_en: Used for paging. If more results are available, set the \`NextStart\` parameter in your next request to this return value
NextStart.description_zh: 分页使用。如果还有更多结果，下次请求将该返回值设置到请求中的NextStart
